test_title: PYST 08: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

She said, "How I wish I could meet him once!"

options.text: She hoped she would meet him.
She exclaimed that she could meet him once.
She said that she wished she could meet him once.
She asked that she meet him once.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that she wished she could meet him once.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"How I wish I could meet him once!" becomes "she wished she could meet him once."**
 
 
• Exclamatory statement "How I wish" is converted to the ve
